mapper.select: /* 회원 메인 위젯 순서 조회 */ SELECT C.COM_CD , C.COM_CD_NM , COALESCE(W.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ) AS SORT_SEQ FROM COM_CD C JOIN COM_CD P ON P.COM_CD_SN = C.COM_CD_PRNT_SN AND P.COM_CD = #{prntComCd} LEFT JOIN MBR_DSHBD_WDGT W ON W.DSHBD_WDGT_CD = C.COM_CD AND W.MBR_SN = #{mbrSn} WHERE C.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY (W.SORT_SEQ IS NULL), COALESCE(W.SORT_SEQ, C.SORT_SEQ), C.SORT_SEQ
mapper.insert: /* 회원 메인 위젯 순서 저장 */ INSERT INTO MBR_DSHBD_WDGT (MBR_SN, DSHBD_WDGT_CD, SORT_SEQ) VALUES (#{mbrSn}, #{dshbdWdgtCd}, #{sortSeq}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SORT_SEQ = VALUES(SORT_SEQ)
